'''Santal Ramoth''' was the first king of [[Amadicia]].

== History ==
In c. {{fy|1015}}, Lord Santal Ramoth tried to reestablish the nation of [[Kharendor]], being a direct descendant of the nation's final king. However, he discovered that Kharendor was no longer a symbol of unity to the people in the area, and that many resident nobles were from other areas of [[Artur Hawkwing's Empire]]. He thus deftly decided to found a new nation, and was crowned the first king of Amadicia in {{fy|1023}}.
